source: Rubinstein v2 §III.11 Hypothesis H12 exact quantifiers, printed pp212-214
nonimplication_1: (forall x exists pair B(x,p)) AND (forall x exists pair M(x,p)) does not imply forall x exists same pair B and M; two-element pair set gives exact witness
nonimplication_2: forall x exists K_x finite does not imply exists uniform K forall x; use required K_x>=x over positive integers
nonimplication_3: arbitrarily large isolated x or bounded multiplicative intervals do not imply arbitrarily large power-width [Z,Z^(3/2)] intervals of success
model3_toy: G_toy(x)=x^(3/4) cos(log x), theta=3/5; G<=0 on [Y_n,e^(pi/3)Y_n] but every sufficiently large [Z,Z^(3/2)] contains x=e^(2*pi*k) where G>x^theta
scope: Simple logical sanity tests, not tests of actual Lean assumptions, not RH disproof.
